5tuntmancamna.text: 5tuntmancamNA never waits for the fight to come to them: upper tier in the matchups, quick on the trigger, and still charging when the opposition gets serious. Bravery is the story here, the numbers keep up as the enemies get stronger, which is rarer than it sounds. Matchups and lifetime board agree, which leaves little room for argument.

5tuntmancamvs.text: 5tuntmancamVS charges straight at the fight: among the very best tracked, furious tempo behind it, growing stronger as foes improve, the toughest-third edge holding high, and lifetime and matchup numbers agree. The aim finds its mark far more often than not. A relentless game, played at full throttle from first to last.

52chainx.text: 52ChainX is a young account off to a roaring start: activity, bravery, and output all sit at the very top, with accuracy and headshots near the top too. Resistance sits well above average and the lifetime IvI near the top. Early read, but the opening already looks the part.

540eurnc.text: 540EurNC is a puzzle: the lifetime kill tally sits near the very top, yet the opponent-weighted picture lands near the bottom. A regular whose raw tally outshines the finer print.
